title: Tôi có thể sạc điện thoại ở đâu?
englishTitle: Where can I charge my phone?
pronunciation: Toi co the sac dien thoai o dau
summary: For finding a safe place to plug in before your phone battery dies at the airport.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask near information desks, cafes, boarding areas, or luggage counters when the battery is low.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the cable or battery screen if needed. You are asking for a place, not a borrowed charger.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể sạc điện thoại ở đâu?
phrases.english: Where can I charge my phone?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the sac dien thoai o dau

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Sạc điện thoại means charge a phone; ở đâu asks where.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi có thể sạc điện thoại ở đâu?
breakdown.english: Where can I charge my phone?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the battery problem changes the plan, move to Wi-Fi, SIM, pickup, or information-desk follow-ups.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good after a long flight, during a delay, before calling a driver, or before opening a mobile ticket.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Airport outlets can be tucked near cafes, columns, or paid lounges. Watch where staff points.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use pickup-area, driver, SIM, Wi-Fi, or baggage follow-ups if the phone issue is part of arrival logistics.
